brand.name: Wanderlush Egypt
brand.shortDescription: Explore Egyptian destinations, choose curated experiences, build a personalised itinerary and see a transparent estimate before you request a booking.

home.heroSupport: Choose the places, pick the experiences, and shape a day-by-day journey with a price that updates as you go.
home.heroSearch: Where do you want to go?
home.mapLabel: Map of Egypt with selectable destinations

destinations.title: Ten places worth the journey
destinations.lead: From the Giza plateau to a chalk desert with no light for two hundred kilometres. Each one says how long it deserves and what a day actually costs.

map.title: Egypt is bigger than the map suggests
map.lead: Cairo to Aswan is a two-hour flight. Siwa is eight hours from the coast. Choose a place to see what it holds and how long it takes to reach.

journeys.title: Journeys we would book ourselves
journeys.lead: Six routes built around how Egypt actually travels. Take one as it is, or open it in the trip builder and make it yours.

experiences.title: The experiences people remember
experiences.lead: A balloon over the Valley of the Kings, three nights on the river, a night under the chalk formations, a wall of coral that drops into open blue.

promises.title: Planning that behaves like a person
promises.lead: No account, no payment, no pressure. Build the trip, see the estimate move, and send it when it looks right.

testimonials.title: What people say afterwards
testimonials.note: Demonstration content for a fictional company. These travellers are invented.

cta.body: Pick a destination, add the experiences you want, and watch the estimate settle. It takes about five minutes and commits you to nothing.

home.heroAlt: The Pyramid of Khafre on the Giza plateau under a clear sky

footer.rights: A fictional travel company, built as a portfolio project.
footer.demoNotice: All destinations, experiences, prices and testimonials on this site are demonstration content.

destinations.title: Ten places worth the journey
destinations.intro: From the Giza plateau to a chalk desert with no light for two hundred kilometres. Each guide covers what to see, when to come and what a day actually costs.

experiences.title: Tours, activities and local experiences
experiences.intro: Twenty-seven experiences across all ten destinations, from a sunrise balloon over the Valley of the Kings to a home-cooked lunch in a Nubian courtyard.

journeys.title: Journeys we would book ourselves
journeys.intro: Six routes built around how Egypt actually travels. Take one as it is, or open it in the trip builder and make it yours.

tripBuilder.title: Build your trip
tripBuilder.intro: Choose destinations, set your dates and party, pick experiences and shape a day-by-day itinerary with a price that updates as you go.

tripSummary.title: Your trip summary
tripSummary.intro: The full itinerary, the cost breakdown and everything you have chosen, in one place.

booking.title: Request your booking
booking.intro: Send your itinerary to a travel specialist. No payment, no commitment, and a reply within one working day.

confirmation.title: Your request is in
confirmation.intro: Keep your booking reference. A specialist will confirm availability and the final quotation.

contact.title: Talk to a travel specialist
contact.intro: Tell us roughly what you have in mind and we will come back within one working day.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Planning, prices, practicalities and what happens after you send a request.

notFound.title: We cannot find that page
notFound.intro: The link may be out of date, or the page may have moved.

placeholder.label: In development
placeholder.body: This part of the journey is being built. The foundation, content and design system it depends on are already in place.

journey.replacesTrip: This replaces the trip you have started.

empty.title: Nothing matches that combination
empty.body: Try widening the season or the length of stay. Egypt is a big country, but not every corner suits every month.

explore.monthRangeHint: Tap one month, or two for a range.
explore.monthRangeNext: Tap a second month to make it a range.

notFound.destination: We do not have a guide for that place
notFound.destinationBody: It may have been renamed, or the link may be out of date. All ten guides are listed below.
notFound.experience: We do not run that experience
notFound.experienceBody: It may have been renamed, or the link may be out of date. Every experience we run is listed below.
notFound.journey: We do not offer that journey
notFound.journeyBody: It may have been renamed, or the link may be out of date. All six journeys are listed below.

empty.title: Nothing matches that combination
empty.body: Try widening the price or the length. Some of the best days out are shorter and cheaper than people expect.

emptySaved.title: You have not saved anything yet
emptySaved.body: Use the bookmark on any experience to keep it here while you decide. Saved experiences stay in this browser.

basics.whenHint: A month is enough to start. If you know the date, add it and the itinerary picks up real days.
basics.whoTitle: Who is travelling, and for how long?
basics.durationHint: The itinerary is checked against this.
basics.childrenHint: Under twelve. Some experiences have a minimum age.
basics.interestsHint: Optional. It orders the experiences we suggest; it never hides any.

places.chooseTitle: Where do you want to go?
places.chooseHint: Pick as many as you like. Each joins the route at its shortest sensible stay; you set the days below. The last day of the trip is the journey home.
places.outOfSeason: Not at its best in the month you chose
places.mapHint: Tap a place on the map to add or remove it.
places.daysLeft_one: {{count}} day of your trip is still unplanned.
places.daysLeft_other: {{count}} days of your trip are still unplanned.
places.daysOver_one: This route is {{count}} day longer than your trip.
places.daysOver_other: This route is {{count}} days longer than your trip.
places.routeEmpty: Nothing chosen yet. Pick places above, or tap them on the map.

transport.long: A long transfer: this takes the whole day.
transport.none: There is no sensible way to do this transfer in one day. Add a night in Cairo between them.

stay.title: Where would you like to stay?
stay.hint_one: Priced for the places on your route. {{count}} room, two to a room.
stay.hint_other: Priced for the places on your route. {{count}} rooms, two to a room.

experiences.title: What would you like to do?
experiences.hint: Ordered by what you told us you care about. Adding one puts it on the emptiest day in that place; you can move it later.
experiences.noPlacesBody: Experiences are picked per place, so the trip needs at least one place before this step has anything to show.

itinerary.title: Your day-by-day itinerary
itinerary.hint: Drag days and experiences into order, or use the arrows. Add free time and transfers so the days read the way they will feel.
itinerary.emptyBody: Choose a place or two and the days appear here, ready to arrange.
itinerary.freeDay: A free day. Add something, or leave it: a holiday needs a few of these.
itinerary.freePlaceholder: A late breakfast, the pool, a walk…
itinerary.whatNext: Next comes the booking request, in the following phase. The estimate beside you already reflects every change.
itinerary.hintTouch: Use the arrows to reorder days and activities, and the day menu on each activity to move it. Add free time and transfers so the days read the way they will feel.

warnings.label: Things to check
warnings.crowdedDay: Day {{day}} is overloaded, with about {{hours}} hours of activities. Move something to another day.
warnings.duplicate: Day {{day}} repeats an experience already on day {{first}}.
warnings.longTransfer: Day {{day}} starts with a transfer of about {{hours}} hours. Keep the rest of that day free.
warnings.noRoute: There is no sensible one-day transfer into day {{day}}. Add a night in Cairo between the two places.
warnings.outOfSeason: The place you reach on day {{day}} is not at its best in the month you chose.
warnings.minAge: An experience on day {{day}} has a minimum age of {{age}}.
warnings.exceedsDuration_one: Your itinerary runs to {{planned}} days but the trip is {{duration}}. Drop one night, or make the trip longer.
warnings.exceedsDuration_other: Your itinerary runs to {{planned}} days but the trip is {{duration}}. Drop {{count}} nights, or make the trip longer.
warnings.underDuration_one: One day of your {{duration}}-day trip is still unplanned: the itinerary covers {{planned}}.
warnings.underDuration_other: {{count}} days of your {{duration}}-day trip are still unplanned: the itinerary covers {{planned}}.
warnings.multiDay_one: An experience on day {{day}} lasts a full day; nothing else fits on it.
warnings.multiDay_other: An experience on day {{day}} lasts {{count}} days; keep the days after it free.
warnings.duplicateSameDay: Day {{day}} has the same experience twice.

summary.title: Your trip so far
summary.estimateNote: An estimate, not a quote: a hotel night for every day but the last at the chosen level, experiences at their shared price, the quickest transfer between places, and our fee. Flights to Egypt are not included.
summary.problems_one: One thing to fix before this can be requested
summary.problems_other: {{count}} things to fix before this can be requested
summary.moreProblems_one: and one more on the itinerary

reset.title: Clear this trip?
reset.body: Everything you have planned is removed from this browser. Your shortlist is cleared too. Nothing has been sent to us.

dnd.instructions: To pick up a day or an activity, press Space or Enter while focused on its handle. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space or Enter to drop it, Escape to cancel.
dnd.overNothing: {{item}} is no longer over a drop area.
